description_expanded: Enjoy fun in the sun at Coastal Villas, a beautiful Destin home located in the private gated community of the Dunes of Destin. With a private beach, lake, and community pool, this upscale community has everything for the perfect Destin getaway! Coastal Villas is a gorgeous three-story home with five bedrooms and three baths accommodating up to sixteen. Stunning interiors welcome you into the expansive space designed for the ultimate relaxation. No detail has been overlooked, from the gorgeous flooring and tilework to the upscale furnishings selected for comfort. The living room is the perfect place to gather, featuring a large sectional sofa, flat-screen TV, and fireplace. Floor-to-ceiling windows bring in plenty of natural light and offer generous views of gorgeous landscaped grounds. The beautifully appointed kitchen provides a bright sunny space to prepare your favorite dishes, and a dining table and breakfast bar ensure plenty of seating for all. Enjoy a cool drink on the expansive outdoor patio or relax on cozy chairs on the lawn while the kids play tag. Bedrooms are just as delightful, with the master suite the star of the show, complete with a king-sized bed, sofa, flat-screen TV, and access to the private patio. Guest suites are just as accommodating, with plush bedding, beautiful art, stunning details, and thoughtful finishes. The kids will love the bunk beds, and a full-sized washer and dryer make cleanups a breeze! Hang out at the pool or venture to the sugar-white shores and enjoy the private beach for hours before hitting the pool come late afternoon. Grab a bite at Lousiana Lagniappe, browse the shops at Destin Commons, or explore the many shops and restaurants at Harborwalk Village. No matter how you spend your days in Destin, you’ll find Coastal Villas an excellent start to the perfect getaway! Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
